method: Same-session Node diagnostic in baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline order. Each fresh Node process executes the unchanged complete readiness-node planning/refresh workload in an identically configured ESM bundle. Exactly definition.js and state-store.js are substituted in the baseline with transpiled HEAD source; candidate transpilation is checked against built modules. Bundling differs from the formal unbundled Node measurement, so these results corroborate comparison within one session and do not replace the full measurement or explain browser variability.

timingContract.planning: SDL parsing/inspection, binding and public operation preparation measured separately
timingContract.refresh: wall time includes operation planning, local GraphQL execute, decode/commit and subscriber projections
timingContract.remainder: wall minus local execute; includes scheduling and all client work, not a direct cache-only measurement
timingContract.statistics: individual samples and min/median/max; no small-sample tail-percentile claims
